See also: entraré

Asturian

[edit]

Verb

[edit]

entrare

  1. first-person singular pluperfect indicative of entrar
  2. third-person singular pluperfect indicative of entrar
  3. first-person singular imperfect subjunctive of entrar
  4. third-person singular imperfect subjunctive of entrar

Italian

[edit]

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • intrare (archaic)

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /enˈtra.re/
  • Audio:(file)
  • Rhymes: -are
  • Hyphenation: en‧trà‧re

Etymology 1

[edit]

From earlier intrare, from Latin intrāre (“to enter”).

Verb

[edit]

entràre (first-person singular present éntro, first-person singular past historic entrài, past participle entràto, auxiliary èssere) (intransitive)

  1. to enter, to go in
  2. to fit, to be contained
  3. (figurative) to emerge, to arise
  4. (figurative) to start, to begin

Related terms
[edit]
  • entrarci

Etymology 2

[edit]

Substantivized form of entrare (“to enter”).

Noun

[edit]

entrare m (plural entrari)

  1. entrance, entry, place of entering
  2. beginning, start

Anagrams

[edit]
  • entrerà, errante, terrena

Spanish

[edit]

Verb

[edit]

entrare

  1. first/third-person singular future subjunctive of entrar
